# @ratmath/numtheory

> Number theory for RatMath: primes with certificates, congruences, Diophantine equations, p-adic numbers, elliptic curves, number fields with proven class groups and units, and zeta and L values. Part of the RatMath Shelf; numbers come from @ratmath/core (a peer dependency). ESM: `import * as numtheory from "@ratmath/numtheory"`.

Built from 0.3.0, commit 74c2c8b. `file:line` is relative to the package root (also node_modules/@ratmath/numtheory/); on GitHub: https://github.com/ratmath/numtheory/blob/74c2c8b/<file>#L<line>. Docs pages are under https://ratmath.com/numtheory/. Full types: index.d.ts.

Types: `type Whole = bigint | number | string | Rational`; `type RationalLike = bigint | number | string | Rational`; `type Certificate = SmallCertificate | PocklingtonCertificate | BLSCertificate | EllipticCertificate`; `type CurvePoint<T> = { readonly x: T; readonly y: T; readonly infinity?: undefined } | { readonly infinity: true }`; `type PointLike<T> = CurvePoint<T> | [RationalLike, RationalLike] | { x: RationalLike; y: RationalLike } | null`; `type ArithmeticFunction = (n: bigint) => bigint`; `type IntPoly = Whole[]`; `type Matrix2 = [[bigint, bigint], [bigint, bigint]]`; `type FormLike = Form | [Whole, Whole, Whole]`; `type FieldLike = NumberField | Order | Array<bigint | number | string | Rational | [bigint, bigint]>`; `type ElementLike = NumberFieldElement | bigint | number | Rational`; `type PlanePoint = [RationalLike, RationalLike] | { re: RationalLike; im?: RationalLike }`

## Docs

- https://ratmath.com/numtheory/llms-full.txt: every page below as Markdown, each with a runnable example
- Pages: index (Overview), reference (Reference), explore (Explore), primes (Primes and certificates), prime-counting (Counting primes), factoring (Factoring), ecm (The elliptic curve method), elliptic-certificates (Elliptic curve certificates), arithmetic-functions (Arithmetic functions), congruences (Congruences), reciprocity (Quadratic reciprocity), squares (Sums of squares), diophantine (Linear equations), continued-fractions (Continued fractions), pell (Pell equations), quadratic-forms (Quadratic forms), elliptic-curves (Elliptic curves), point-counting (Counting points), number-fields (Rings of integers), prime-ideals (Prime ideals), class-groups (Class groups), units (Units), characters (Dirichlet characters), l-values (Zeta and L values), padic (p-adic numbers)

## Example

```js
import { primePi, factor, formatFactors, provePrime, verifyCertificate, twoSquaresAll, pellSolutions, classGroup, classNumber, padic, idealClassGroup, zetaValue } from "@ratmath/numtheory";
// primes, proofs and a little of everything
const p = provePrime(2n ** 107n - 1n);
console.log("2^107 − 1:", p.certificate.kind, verifyCertificate(p.certificate));
console.log("F₆ =", formatFactors(factor(2n ** 64n + 1n)));
console.log("1105 as two squares:", twoSquaresAll(1105).map(([a, b]) => `${a}² + ${b}²`).join(", "));
console.log("x² − 2y² = 7:", pellSolutions(2, 7).solutions(5));
console.log("h(−3299) =", classNumber(-3299), "structure", classGroup(-3299).structure);
console.log("Q(∛65):", String(idealClassGroup([-65n, 0n, 0n, 1n])));
console.log("π(10¹⁰) =", primePi(10n ** 10n), "  ζ(3) ∈", zetaValue(3).compactedDecimalInterval());
padic("1/3", 5n).toString(16)
```
